archetypes.name: pattern-clause-ordering
archetypes.rationale: The plan prescribes a precise clause ordering (sidecar-deny → static-codex-deny → dynamic-codex-allow → broad-output-allow) inside round_artifact_included(); verifying this ordering does not interact with existing denies to leak .prompt/.events.jsonl requires tracing each clause against the current code.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the proposed clause ordering in `round_artifact_included()` in `scripts/larch-log.sh` against the current implementation. Verify that the new dynamic Codex explicit-allow clause is positioned AFTER all sidecar/diagnostic/telemetry deny patterns so `.prompt`, `.events.jsonl`, `.diag`, and `.done` files cannot fall through to the allow. Cross-check the same ordering concern in `design_round_artifact_included()` in `scripts/lib-design-round-artifacts.sh`. Confirm that the plan's ordering description maps unambiguously to the existing code structure and that no existing deny clause is accidentally shadowed or reordered. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: fixture-producer-name
archetypes.rationale: The plan renames test fixtures (e.g., codex-plan-edge-output.txt → codex-primary-plan-edge-output.txt, dyn-cursor-plan-foo-output.txt → cursor-plan-dyn-foo-output.txt) to match real producer filenames; these names must be verified against actual artifact-producer code, not assumed correct.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit every fixture name the plan introduces or renames in `scripts/test-lib-design-round-artifacts.sh` and `scripts/test-larch-log-write-round.sh`. For each renamed name (e.g., `codex-primary-plan-*-output.txt`, `cursor-plan-dyn-foo-output.txt`, `codex-primary-plan-dyn-foo-output.txt`) search the scope files and any related artifact-producer code to confirm these naming conventions are real and not still fictional. Flag any fixture name that cannot be traced to an actual artifact producer in the codebase. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: doc-scope-precision
archetypes.rationale: The plan makes a conditional doc-sync decision (sync test-lib-design-round-artifacts.md only if its summary names changed fixtures) and requires documentation to be scoped to plan-review/round-N artifacts only; these constraints are easy to under-specify and could leave docs inconsistent or make overly broad exclusion claims.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review every documentation update step in the plan against `scripts/lib-design-round-artifacts.md`, `scripts/larch-log.md`, and `scripts/test-larch-log-write-round.md`. Verify that the plan's scoping language ('plan-review/round-N artifacts only', 'behavior is unchanged') is precise enough to prevent future maintainers from inferring broader design-log exclusion guarantees. Check whether the conditional sync rule for `scripts/test-lib-design-round-artifacts.md` could leave that doc inconsistent with its corresponding test file after the fixture renames. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
